findings.title: Required old-owner conversion release gate cannot execute without retained old state
findings.observed: With the exact accepted #868 old binary supplied, the ignored release-gate test exits 101 before exercising candidate behavior because ISSUE872_OLD_STATE is required.
findings.impact: Issue #873 cannot claim the complete conversion/recovery denominator or an overall passing qualification.
findings.scope_boundary: The passing retained #872 validator and the passing current-candidate conversion suites remain valid corroboration, but neither substitutes for this required gate.
findings.recommended_disposition: Restore an authenticated, portable old-state fixture or repair the release-gate harness in the owning issue, then rerun this exact gate.
